user.title: KMA Weather
user.description: This base setup requires the KMA Short Forecast API (기상청_단기예보 조회서비스). Enter that API key and choose a zone entity. The integration reads the zone latitude/longitude, converts it to KMA grid coordinates, and then asks you to pick one of the three nearest KMA administrative area candidates.

area_choice.title: Choose KMA area
area_choice.description: Select one of the three nearest KMA administrative area candidates for living weather indices.

error.zone_not_found: Selected zone entity was not found.
error.zone_missing_coordinates: The selected zone does not have latitude/longitude attributes.
error.area_code_not_found: Could not map the selected zone coordinates to a KMA area code.
error.invalid_area_choice: Choose one of the suggested KMA area candidates.

init.title: KMA Weather options
init.description: Control failure tolerance and optionally add one API group at a time. The base KMA API key is reused for all supported add-on groups. Group bundles create all related sensors automatically, and unneeded entities can be disabled later in Home Assistant.
